text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day arrived for the fan tea party that Tokai Teio
and the others had been preparing for.
I had also received an invitation...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The day is finally here...
I'm so glad I won the lottery~!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've never been to a tea party before,
so what if my manners are terrible? What if I mess up—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, don't worry about a thing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After all, your host today is none other than me,
Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
!!!!
T-Tokai Teio-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
First, please enjoy some welcome tea.
I hope it suits your taste.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it has such a lovely fruity aroma...
It's delicious...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Would you care for some refreshments to go with it?
The rule of thumb is working your way up from the bottom—
sandwiches, scones, then pastries—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But honestly, eat whatever you feel like in the moment!
It's totally not a breach of etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?! That sounds way less
intimidating than I thought...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nishishi! See, totally fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I put together this party because
I wanted all my fans to have fun, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So just relax your shoulders and enjoy
a vibe that's a little different from the usual!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pardon me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If it pleases you,
would you care to share a dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
!?!?!?
I-Is this straight out of a shojo manga...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you don't get many chances to do this normally,
right? So why not take the opportunity to try it out?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How about you too?
Wanna dance with me?
choice_data_list: I'm not sure if I can dance well, but sure...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing the very essence of formality...
I see. It appears to be going swimmingly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Allowing them to have fun while maintaining the atmosphere—
I was surprised when she first proposed it,
but it seems wonderfully suited for a fan event.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...You have refined your mischievous spark with great skill, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It wrapped up without a hitch, Teio-san!
The fans all seemed so thoroughly pleased!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nisshishi♪ Of course they were,
since I was the one hosting!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yup, yup! You have my royal approval!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding. As you could probably tell,
I'm really not good with stuffy, uptight rules.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When I was learning etiquette, I was just following instructions
without understanding what it was all even for.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even when I attended actual parties, it was just
restriction after restriction—so boring that I'd just bolt out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...But talking with McQueen made me realize.
There's actually a real reason behind all those strict rules.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And being able to understand that means
I've grown up a bunch, don'tcha think?!
Well? Pretty grown-up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! All right, gotta go tell
the Prez all about this too! Preeeez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In addition to her natural energetic spirit,
a budding awareness as a refined lady was taking root
within Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her growth like this
brought a truly heartwarming feeling
to my chest.
